protocol.title: Digital Signaling Decouples Activation Probability and Population Heterogeneity
protocol.platform: Automated microfluidic cell culture (PDMS chip) + widefield fluorescence live-cell microscopy + 96-well bulk qPCR
protocol.cell_line: p65-knockout NIH 3T3 fibroblasts expressing p65-DsRed (NF-kB reporter) and H2B-GFP (nuclear reporter); clonally derived at lowest detectable p65-DsRed expression to preserve near-endogenous levels
protocol.objective: Characterise how stimulus dose (amplitude) and duration determine NF-kB digital activation probability and single-cell response heterogeneity under LPS and TNF stimulation; demonstrate the Area Rule (stimulus integral = concentration x duration controls fraction of responding cells)

device.reference: Gomez-Sjoberg et al. 2007 (Anal. Chem. 79:8557); Kellogg et al. 2014 (Nat. Protoc. 9:1713)
device.conditions_per_chip: All LPS doses tested in parallel; duplicate chambers per condition
device.image_stitching: ImageJ Pairwise stitching plugin (1-2 images per chamber)

reagents.cell_culture_media: Complete growth media (DMEM + 10% FBS), equilibrated to 5% CO2 before stimulation
reagents.coating_agent: Fibronectin solution; chambers pre-treated to promote cell adhesion

lps_stimulus.conversion_note: 1 ng/mL LPS = 2.4e4 molecules per cell in microfluidic chamber (MW 10 kDa, chamber 1.12x0.9x0.040 mm, ~100 cells/chamber)

reagents.cdna_kit: Invitrogen One-Step RT-PCR kit (specific target amplification with 24-primer set)

steps.name: Fibronectin coating and cell seeding
steps.notes: ~200 cells/chamber; grown for 1 day with periodic media replenishment to ~80% confluence at 37 C / 5% CO2

steps.name: LPS dose-modulation stimulation (LL high-dose arm: 500 ng/mL)
steps.delivery: Step increase by media exchange; continuous flow to replace internalized ligand

expected_outcome.dynamics: Rapid, synchronous; sustained oscillations under continuous LPS flow

steps.name: LPS dose-modulation stimulation (LL low-dose arm: 0.25 ng/mL)
steps.delivery: Step increase by media exchange; continuous flow

expected_outcome.dynamics: Delayed, variable activation; stereotypical peak shape shifted later in time

steps.name: LPS duration-modulation stimulation (SS short-pulse arm: 1 s @ 500 ng/mL)
steps.delivery: 1 s flow of LPS at 500 ng/mL; immediate media wash to terminate receptor contact

expected_outcome.notes: Same responding fraction as 0.25 ng/mL continuous LL arm (~3-5%); response dynamics fast and synchronous unlike LL low-dose arm

steps.name: LPS duration-modulation stimulation (SS long-pulse arm: 40 s @ 500 ng/mL)
steps.delivery: 40 s flow of LPS at 500 ng/mL; immediate media wash to terminate receptor contact

expected_outcome.notes: Median peak time shifts < 2 min vs 1 s arm despite >25x increase in responding fraction; no significant timing difference (p-value from Figure 5 supplement 2)

steps.name: Off-chip gene expression assay (96-well plate, LPS dose-modulation)

rna_extraction.ir_500: rna5001[0] = mix(stimWell5001[0], lysate5001[0]) @ 300.0SECOND; cdna5001[0] = mix(rna5001[0], primers5001[0]) @ 1800.0SECOND

expected_outcome.500_ng_mL: Early gene peaks at 30 min; intermediate genes peak at 1-2 h
expected_outcome.50_ng_mL: Dose-dependent delay: nfkbia/a20 peak shifts to ~1 h; nfkbie/tnf peak shifts to 2 h; ccl20/icam1 peaks shift to 2-3 h
expected_outcome.late_genes_note: casp4 and ccl5 do not reflect NF-kB activation delay due to slow induction kinetics

area_rule.description: Stimulus integral (concentration x duration) determines fraction of cells that activate NF-kB in the population. Validated analytically, by simulation, and experimentally.
area_rule.analytical_basis: For high-dose inputs where backward reaction (ligand-receptor dissociation) is negligible, fraction of activation P([AB] >= [AB]_th) depends only on input area S = integral(concentration dt). See Appendix 1, Equation 2.
area_rule.caveat: At sub-threshold doses, increasing duration infinitely does not exceed maximal activation fraction for that dose; Area Rule has a dose-dependent ceiling.

experimental_validation.conclusion: Equal area conditions produce statistically equivalent responding fractions regardless of temporal profile

mathematical_model.base_model: IKK-NF-kB regulatory module from Tay et al. 2010 (Nature 466:267)
mathematical_model.cell_to_cell_variability_source: TLR4 receptor number; lognormal distribution (mu=8.0, sigma=0.8); expected 4.1e3 receptors/cell

cooperative_activation.mechanism: Myddosome assembly and TRAF6 lattice clustering
cooperative_activation.note: Hill coefficient n=4 for IKK activation by TRAF6; distinct from population-level dose-response Hill coefficient of 2.3

mathematical_model.lps_branch_modeled: TLR4-MyD88-dependent branch only (early response); TLR4-TRIF-dependent branch removed for simplification
mathematical_model.cd14_simplification: CD14 removed (assumed in excess); LPS binds TLR4 directly in model
mathematical_model.parameter_estimation: Iterative automatic (L2-norm, log-scale sampling) + manual approach; 200 simulations per parameter set

image_analysis.nfkb_quantification: Mean nuclear DsRed fluorescence normalized to mean cytoplasm intensity
image_analysis.peak_analysis: Matlab smooth() + mspeaks(); manual verification via custom Matlab interface
image_analysis.peak_area_integration: Matlab trapz(); baseline-corrected from LPS stimulation to first minimum

basic_blocks.content: fibronectin coat, cell seed (1440m), LL LPS dispense, llHighChamber and llLowChamber stimulation (250m), detect NF-kB translocation, if-gate on llHighSignal
dispose llHighSignal, llLowSignal; seed SS cells (1440m); 1s and 40s LPS pulses + media wash; detect NF-kB; if-gate on ss40sSignal
dispose ss1sSignal, ss40sSignal; seed bulk cells (1440m); stimulate 500 and 50 ng/mL (480m); lyse, RT-PCR, Fluidigm qPCR; if-gate on gexSignal500

duration_conversions.note: BioScript compiler accepts s and m only; all h values pre-converted to m in .bs file
